projects.title: Build a simple home lab
projects.description: Set up virtual machines and an intentionally vulnerable target in an isolated lab.
projects.safetyNote: Keep vulnerable targets isolated; do not expose them to the public internet or test systems without authorization.

projects.title: Security lab notes and CTF portfolio
projects.description: Publish lab notes, CTF writeups, screenshots, and lessons learned on GitHub.
projects.safetyNote: Do not publish secrets, credentials, personal data, or exploit details for live third-party targets.

projects.title: Basic incident-response checklist
projects.description: Create a checklist for a common security incident scenario.

projects.title: Personal security-hygiene guide
projects.description: Create a guide to safe digital habits that can be taught to peers or a community group.

projects.title: Beginner CTF writeups
projects.description: Solve beginner challenges on authorized CTF platforms and document the approach and lessons learned.
projects.safetyNote: Only interact with the CTF targets and systems authorized by the platform.
